source_scope: Pinned upstream source only: CLI parser/help, config descriptors and typed maps, input/help bindings, menu implementations/options categories, shared data structures and draw/collection declarations.
denominator_method: One row per CLI behavior, public config key, user action binding, menu surface/category, or data family. Flags with identical semantics are grouped; -v is separate from -V/--version because its output differs.
